program.rationale:
This program is designed for a beginner aiming to build muscle, training 3 days a week with dumbbells. For muscle growth (hypertrophy), moderate loads with roughly 6-12 reps per set are recommended [notes-program-design-1]. Beginners can start with 1-3 sets per exercise [notes-program-design-1]. Rest periods of 1-3 minutes are generally advised for hypertrophy [notes-program-design-1], though some sources suggest 30-90 seconds [singer2024-rest-0]. This program uses 60-90 seconds to allow for adequate recovery while keeping the session efficient. Each major muscle group will be trained at least twice a week, which is suitable for beginners [notes-program-design-1].

Day 1 and Day 3 include a squat, hinge, horizontal push, and core exercise. Day 2 includes a lunge, hinge, vertical push, and carry. This full-body approach is effective for beginners [notes-program-design-2].
